verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Disputes API that lets an application complete the steps of the disputes process, plus registrable webhooks managed through a Webhook Subscriptions API, so an agent has an official programmatic route into disputes. The evidence, however, never shows dispute-specific webhook events, deadline fields, or evidence upload and draft-then-review handling. Missing for 10: documented dispute webhook events, a due-date or deadline field for monitoring, evidence upload and draft-before-submit workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review

citations.quote: The Disputes API allows a seller to use your application to complete the steps of the disputes process.
Learn about the Webhook Subscriptions API, which you can use to programmatically subscribe to webhooks.
Learn about Square webhooks, which let developers receive real-time notifications of events
